capabilities: export notes to formats via Pandoc (HTML, DOCX, ePub, PDF, LaTeX, Hugo Markdown)
substitute output, file, vault and frontmatter variables in custom commands
copy media resources together with Markdown and HTML exports
extras: Author notes that only Markdown, Markdown (Hugo) and HTML exports are well tested across Mac OS, Windows and Linux; other formats are not tested well.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export notes with their media to external document formats like DOCX, ePub or LaTeX.

relations.evidence: This is an enhancing export plugin base on Pandoc for Obsidian

summary: Pandoc-based exporter that converts notes to Markdown (including Hugo), HTML, DOCX, LaTeX and other formats, bundled with their media resources.
